scene: A warm chestnut fuels your spirit before three grand transport stations.
picture: A snowy transport terminal beside the pond. On the far left, a hillside chairlift platform holds swinging empty chairs. Left of centre stands the boy in orange puffer vest, holding an empty paper cone. At centre idles a red sleigh tram on ice tracks. On the far right, a glass-bottomed boat is tied to a dock.
shown: a dangling metal chairlift station with swinging yellow chairs on the far left
a long red sleigh tram idling on polished ice tracks at centre
a moored glass-bottomed motorboat floating at a snowy wooden pier on the far right
